newsitem.title: UK: Texaco shortlists tankers for Angola FSO.
newsitem.headline: Texaco shortlists tankers for Angola FSO.

text.p: U.S. oil company Texaco Inc has shortlisted five very large crude carriers for work as a floating storage and offloading facility off Angola, shipbrokers Galbraiths said on Friday.
Texaco will inspect the vessels, all built in the mid-1970s, and concurrently invite owners' proposals for sale, time-charter or bare-boat.
The selected vessel, to be employed for up to 15 years on the field, will be converted and installed off Angola within 1997, Galbraiths said.

Galbraiths did not elaborate but the arrangement appears to refer to Angola's Block Two, where Texaco is the operator, working with state oil company Sonangol, French oil company Total, and Brazil's Petroleo Brasileiro SA.

Texaco in May was named operator of Block 22, a new deepwater oil field off Angola's coast. Texaco is a shareholder on an onshore production field near Angola's northern port city of Soyo and offshore on blocks 16 and 20.
